summary: Verified both Expo Go crash fixes. (1) Cold-start on web preview at http://localhost:3000/ renders the Hack-Seguro welcome screen cleanly with 3 CTAs — NO 'expo-notifications does not support Expo Go' crash text in DOM, NO thrown errors, NO console errors referencing expo-notifications/setNotificationHandler/ExpoGo. Only a benign library-internal warning ('Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web') which is not from our code and is a warning, not an exception. (2) Static analysis: `Notifications.setNotificationHandler` appears exactly ONCE and is inside `registerForPush()` body (line 34, function spans lines 23-71). No other file in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/app references expo-notifications. All 7 `Notifications.*` calls in push.ts sit inside the function, gated by Platform.OS!=='web', Device.isDevice, and Constants.appOwnership!=='expo' checks. (3) app.json: `expo.android.googleServicesFile` key is absent; `expo.plugins` still contains 'expo-notifications'; `android.package`, `android.permissions`, `ios.bundleIdentifier` still present. `npx expo config --json` parses successfully with zero warnings (previous 'Could not parse Expo config' warnings only appeared in older log lines before the restart; the current metro run is clean). (4) Regression smoke: /api/auth/register→200 and /api/referrals/mine→200 both pass.
critical_code_review_comments: push.ts is now import-safe: all expo-notifications APIs are gated inside registerForPush() with three guards (web, non-device, Expo Go). handlerConfigured flag ensures setNotificationHandler runs at most once. Clean fix.

Consider deleting the stray `Could not parse Expo config` log lines from older supervisor sessions by clearing /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log; current process no longer emits them. Not a functional issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Expo Go crash fixes are validated. push.ts is import-safe, app.json parses cleanly, and auth+referrals endpoints unaffected. The residual expo-notifications web warning ('Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web') is emitted by the expo-notifications library itself when imported on web — it is a warning, not an exception, and does not affect functionality. Test file for future regressions: /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_push_fix.py.
rca_of_issue: Original crash RCA: `Notifications.setNotificationHandler({...})` was invoked at module top-level inside src/push.ts. Because src/auth.tsx imports registerForPush from push.ts, that top-level call ran during the JS bundle boot on Expo Go, where the underlying native notifications module is not linked, raising 'expo-notifications functionality is not fully supported in Expo Go'. Fix moves the handler + all Notifications.* calls inside registerForPush(), guarded so they never execute in web or Expo Go environments. Secondary warning ('missing google-services.json') came from a dangling expo.android.googleServicesFile pointing to a non-existent file — removed from app.json until a real FCM config is added at build time.
